item.title: HIV/AIDS Clinical Trials Network Leadership and Operations Centers (UM1 Clinical Trial Required)
item.description: The purpose of this notice of funding opportunity (NOFO) is to support HIV/AIDS Clinical Trials Network Leadership and Operations Centers (LOCs). Each LOC will oversee research prioritization, planning, and conduct of studies in a HIV/AIDS Clinical Trials Network to advance research in the prevention and treatment of HIV and HIV-associated diseases.

item.title: HIV/AIDS Clinical Trials Network Laboratory Centers (UM1 Clinical Trial Required)
item.description: The purpose of the notice of funding opportunity (NOFO) is to support HIV/AIDS Clinical Trials Network Laboratory Centers (LCs). The LCs will provide a framework for laboratory leadership, structure and activities that contribute to the HIV/AIDS Clinical Trials Networks research agendas and execute the laboratory component of Network trials, in compliance with applicable regulatory standards.

item.title: HIV/AIDS Clinical Trials Network Statistical and Data Management Centers (UM1 Clinical Trial Required)
item.description: The purpose of this notice of funding opportunity (NOFO) is to support HIV/AIDS Clinical Trials Network Statistical and Data Management Centers (SDMCs). The SDMCs will be responsible for the statistical and data management leadership and coordination critical to the HIV/AIDS Clinical Trials Networks.

item.title: HIV/AIDS Clinical Trials Network Clinical Trials Units (UM1 Clinical Trial Required)
item.description: The purpose of this notice of funding opportunity (NOFO) is to support HIV/AIDS Clinical Trials Network Clinical Trials Units (CTUs). CTUs will provide the infrastructure, as well as the scientific and administrative expertise to conduct clinical studies developed by NIH HIV/AIDS Clinical Trials Networks to advance research in the prevention and treatment of HIV and HIV-associated diseases.
